verdict.rationale: GrowthBook ships a large set of official SDKs: 24 per GitHub, with first-party docs for JS, React, Vue, Kotlin, Swift and Flutter. All SDKs share the same assignment logic and a 400+ test conformance suite. Community users report integrating in minutes with under 10 lines of code, and in a few hours for a Vue frontend; the 2021 comment saying there were no native mobile SDKs predates the current Kotlin/Swift SDK docs. Missing for 10: a hands-on probe exercising an SDK client library itself (the runtime probe only hit the SDK payload endpoint), and per-SDK depth beyond summary pages.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: 24 SDKs including React, Python, Android, and iOS.
All SDKs use the same assignment logic, so the same attributes always produce the same variation regardless of which SDK you use.
Use the GrowthBook React SDK to evaluate feature flags and run A/B tests in React, including client and server components.
Install the GrowthBook Swift SDK to evaluate feature flags and run A/B tests on iOS, macOS, tvOS, and other Apple platforms.
We had Growthbook working in roughly 15 minutes with under 10 lines of code changed.
